registration.uncertaintyNote: Approximate3–5m feature position, ±3m eastern-head axial depth; exact western closure unknown. These are conservative visual-model tolerances, not statistical confidence intervals.
registration.method: Manual digitisation of the published2017 photogrammetric restitution after affine matching of its raster to the SAME ICV2012 orthophoto, then anchoring to the conserved southern gate. The rounded model is an interpretation, not an exact survey.
sourceLocalizers: Tarraco Biennal2017, Melchor et al., pp155–160: p159 spina151m; p160fig5 expressly labels white boundary as possible total-length hypothesis.
ICV2012 RGB orthophoto50cm, official WMS. PNOA current mosaic used only for visual comparison; mosaic flight date not specified by GetMap.
cautions: Do not use the white western arc as excavated carceres: the source says the western closure cannot be located precisely.

The printed graphic outline measures roughly260m in this georeferencing, whereas the text supplies270–290m and table273approx. Preserve that discrepancy and the western uncertainty, rather than treating the figure as a millimetric architectural plan.
The ellipse22x35m is a deliberately rounded graphic inference, not a newly established archaeological dimension.
Use151m spina from the revised2017 study. The earlier190m report belongs to a different dimensional reconstruction.
Do not infer arena, roof, tribune or carceres heights from the plan. Do not use image-matching residuals as survey error.

controlFit.method: Affine raster matching to the same official ICV 2012 orthophoto, visually checked; no independent surveyed ground-control network.
controlFit.figure: Melchor et al., ARSE51 (2017), p43 fig17, extracted native443x378px
controlFit.precisionWarning: Patch residual describes matching of two copies of the same image only. It is NOT archaeological position accuracy; retain3–5m tolerance for the traced features.
